use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES
use System.Math

use Point = (x: double, y: double, z: double)

let size = 180
let frames = 40

dot(a: Point, b: Point) -> double => a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

scale(p: Point, k: double) -> Point =>
    (x = p.x * k, y = p.y * k, z = p.z * k)

let up = scale((x = 1.0D, y = 1.0D, z = 1.0D), 1.0D / Math.sqrt(3.0D))
let across = scale((x = 1.0D, y = -1.0D, z = 0.0D), 1.0D / Math.sqrt(2.0D))
let toward: Point = (
    x = up.y * across.z - up.z * across.y,
    y = up.z * across.x - up.x * across.z,
    z = up.x * across.y - up.y * across.x)

let corners =
    (0..8)
        |> map(i => (
            x = if i & 1 == 0 then -1.0D else 1.0D fi,
            y = if i & 2 == 0 then -1.0D else 1.0D fi,
            z = if i & 4 == 0 then -1.0D else 1.0D fi))
        |> collect_list()

let faces = [
    (corners = [0, 2, 6, 4], normal = (x = -1.0D, y = 0.0D, z = 0.0D)),
    (corners = [1, 3, 7, 5], normal = (x = 1.0D, y = 0.0D, z = 0.0D)),
    (corners = [0, 1, 5, 4], normal = (x = 0.0D, y = -1.0D, z = 0.0D)),
    (corners = [2, 3, 7, 6], normal = (x = 0.0D, y = 1.0D, z = 0.0D)),
    (corners = [0, 1, 3, 2], normal = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D, z = -1.0D)),
    (corners = [4, 5, 7, 6], normal = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D, z = 1.0D))
]

let light = scale((x = -0.5D, y = 0.8D, z = 0.4D), 1.0D / Math.sqrt(1.05D))

turned(p: Point, angle: double) -> Point =>
    let a = dot(p, across), b = dot(p, toward) in
    (
        x = a * Math.cos(angle) + b * Math.sin(angle),
        y = dot(p, up),
        z = b * Math.cos(angle) - a * Math.sin(angle))

draw(image: IMAGE, angle: double) is
    image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 247ub)

    let shapes = SHAPES()
    let outlines = LIST[Collections.List[(x: double, y: double)]]()

    for face in faces do
        let normal = turned(face.normal, angle)

        if normal.z > 0.0D then
            let outline =
                face.corners
                    |> map(i => turned(corners[i], angle))
                    |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y))
                    |> collect_list()

            let bright = 0.3D + 0.7D * Math.max(0.0D, dot(normal, light))

            shapes.add(
                outline,
                cast ubyte(70.0D * bright),
                cast ubyte(130.0D * bright),
                cast ubyte(210.0D * bright))

            outlines.add(outline)
        fi
    od

    image.fill(shapes)

    image.colour(20ub, 30ub, 50ub)
    image.stroke(1.5D)

    for outline in outlines do
        image.line(outline |> cat([outline[0]]) |> collect_list())
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

image.view(-2.0D, -2.0D, 2.0D, 2.0D)

let animation = ANIMATION(size, size)

for frame in 0..frames do
    let turn = cast double(frame) / cast double(frames)
    let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi / 3.0D * turn

    draw(image, angle)
    animation.add(image, 50)
od

write_line("{frames} frames, a third of a turn: the cube looks the same")
write_line("again after 120 degrees about its vertical diagonal")

animation.write("cube.png")

animation.show("cube.png")
